title: fix(aws): honor language passed to STT.stream()

files.patch:
@@ -17,7 +17,7 @@
 import contextlib
 import os
 import time
-from dataclasses import dataclass
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
 from typing import Any
 
 from livekit import rtc
@@ -208,10 +208,18 @@ def stream(
         language: NotGivenOr[str] = NOT_GIVEN,
         conn_options: APIConnectOptions = DEFAULT_API_CONNECT_OPTIONS,
     ) -> SpeechStream:
+        opts = self._config
+        # language_code cannot be combined with automatic language identification
+        if language and (opts.identify_language or opts.identify_multiple_languages):
+            logger.warning(
+                "language is ignored when identify_language or identify_multiple_languages is enabled"
+            )
+        elif language:
+            opts = replace(opts, language=LanguageCode(language))
         return SpeechStream(
             stt=self,
             conn_options=conn_options,
-            opts=self._config,
+            opts=opts,
             credentials=self._credentials,
         )

@@ -314,3 +314,22 @@ async def await_output():
     finally:
         await stream.aclose()
         await provider.aclose()
+
+
+async def test_aws_stream_applies_language_override():
+    provider = aws_stt.STT(region="us-east-1", language="en-US")
+    override = provider.stream(language="es-US", conn_options=APIConnectOptions(max_retry=0))
+    default = provider.stream(conn_options=APIConnectOptions(max_retry=0))
+    # an empty override means no override: the configured language is kept
+    empty = provider.stream(language="", conn_options=APIConnectOptions(max_retry=0))
+    try:
+        assert override._opts.language == "es-US"
+        assert default._opts.language == "en-US"
+        assert empty._opts.language == "en-US"
+        # the override applies to that stream only
+        assert provider._config.language == "en-US"
+    finally:
+        await override.aclose()
+        await default.aclose()
+        await empty.aclose()
+        await provider.aclose()
